$comment: Single source of truth for which Solidity contract suites are excluded from the PR gate. unitExclude is the ONLY place a new exclusion category is added: invariantMatch/forkMatch must each be one of its branches, and jsExclude is a derived mirror (sync-facts.mjs --write regenerates it). GitHub Actions cannot read this file from env:, so workflow files are asserted by --check and updated by hand.
